newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mandela's ruling ANC R41 million in the red - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mandela's ruling ANC R41 million in the red - paper.

text.p: President Nelson Mandela's ruling African National Congress was 41 million rand ($9.3 million) in the red, the party treasurer-general told South Africa's Sunday Independent newspaper.
Arnold Stofile told the paper millions of rands had been lost through a number of business ventures set up to create jobs and generate profit for the ANC.
"We had a 15 million rand overdraft on our general election account and 16 million rand on our general account and the rest we owed in other various accounts," Stofile said.

"We are not secretive about this. We have the capacity to wipe out the overdraft...In 1994 we were 74 million rand in the red and three months later we had recovered and had a credit balance. Our situation is improving."
